CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b (
                target_id varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    etl_date varchar(30) NOT NULL,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00001 varchar(1000),
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00002 varchar(1000),
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00007 varchar(1000),
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010 DOUBLE PRECISION,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00011 varchar(1000),
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00012 varchar(1000),
                created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
            ) PARTITION BY RANGE (etl_date);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b_target_id ON dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b (target_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b_etl_date ON dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b (etl_date);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b_i_dep_acct_no_offline_00001 ON dep_acct_wide_table_5e6f7a8b (i_dep_acct_no_offline_00001);

SELECT
    target_id,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00001,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00002,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00007,
    CASE WHEN i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010 IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010 AS STRING)) = '' THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) WHEN TRIM(CAST(i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010 AS STRING)) RLIKE '^-?(\\d+(\\.\\d*)?|\\.\\d+)([eE][+-]?\\d+)?$' THEN CAST(TRIM(CAST(i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010 AS STRING)) AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00011,
    i_dep_acct_no_offline_00012,
    '2026-10-09' as etl_date
FROM (
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        target_id,
        indicator_id,
        indicator_value
    FROM hxb_dh_data_dwm.dwm_taosha_indicator_details
    WHERE etl_date = '2026-10-09'
      AND object_type = 'dep_acct_no'
      AND target_id is not null
) AS source_data
PIVOT (
    MAX(indicator_value)
    FOR indicator_id IN ('i_dep_acct_no_offline_00001' AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00001, 'i_dep_acct_no_offline_00002' AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00002, 'i_dep_acct_no_offline_00007' AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00007, 'i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010' AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00010, 'i_dep_acct_no_offline_00011' AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00011, 'i_dep_acct_no_offline_00012' AS i_dep_acct_no_offline_00012)
)
) AS pivot_result
